Dialogs.Dialog: Sorry for calling you out so suddenly...
I don't mind, but what did you want to talk about？
Today, I have something I want to give you, Senpai...
My gaze as I look at you... your gaze as you look at me...
Where our eyes meet, they weave... ah, a spiral labyrinth.
Will your hand rescue me from this labyrinth？
Or will your chains lock my heart away in a prison？
Either way, it doesn't matter. Because your magic eyes will never let me go, for all eternity...
Th-that's not it！ Oh no！ I'm so scatterbrained...
This is the real one！ Please read this one！
The sky is so very blue, but my heart is cloudy.
Even when I walk ten steps faster on purpose, he passes me by like he doesn't notice.
I notice a feeling like watching the back of a bus I missed. Loneliness.
About the letters... please pretend they never happened after all...
I think this kind of thing... has to be said in my own words！
So, change of plans！ Today I... um... kind of panicked...
Once I've sorted out my thoughts a bit, will you listen to me again？
Well then, thank you very much！
Ah... I haven't introduced myself yet, have I？
Nene Anegasaki. 14 years old, second year of middle school. Currently in the middle of a one-sided crush！
Must be nice～. I really want someone to confess to me...
(This... I should just take it, right？)
Come on！ Catch me if you can～!! Hehehe！
(Oh...！ Could this be...!? All right！ I'll splash her some more！)
Geez！ I said stop！ I'll get wet！
Not yet, not yet～！ Take that！
Aww. Geez～！ Now I'm soaking wet！
Ah... sorry, sorry！ Did I overdo it？
You're getting way too carried away！
I have to dry off... wait a sec.
Huh!? Oh, it was a dream...
(All right, I'll prank her by splashing water on her shirt！)
Okay, everyone, it's song and dance time？
Teacher？ ...Wait, where is this？ I'm... small!?
Geez, what's wrong？ Not feeling well？
Then, let's start song and dance time？
...That's a bit much, even for me...
You have to do it properly. No slacking. Okaay, hands on your head... Ponpoko-rin～♪
(Did I have fun doing stuff like this when I was a kid too？)
Ponpoko Kick！ ...Kicking, at song and dance time!?
Well done～. Next is Ponpoko Jump.
Squat down flat, and wiggle your tail～.
Wiggle your tail～... huh？ From Teacher's... bottom...
Okay, once more. Wiggle your tail～.
That's right？ You have a tail too, don't you？
Huh？ ...Ah！ I have a tail too!?
Hehe. We're tanuki, so everyone has one, you know？
I-I didn't know. I was a tanuki...
I'm a tanuki, you're a tanuki, everyone's a tanuki, Ponpoko-rin～♪
R-right. Yeah, I'm a tanuki too...
Of course, it was a dream.
Why would I dream something like that？ Tanuki...
But ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ as a preschool teacher was kind of nice.
Apparently a new teacher's coming starting today. I wonder what they're like？
I hope it's a pretty, soothing type...
(A sexy type like this isn't bad either...)
Look at me. Look at me...？ Understood？
(Heart or tanuki？ Then, heart for now.)
(So I just say the same thing after the teacher...)
(I just have to copy the teacher...)
Hey！ That's still a little early for you, isn't it？ Little Mr. Grown-up...
Well then, that's it for today's lesson. See you later！
I can't tell ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ I had a dream like this...
(Better not, or the whip will come flying again...)
Say "I love you" into the microphone.
Say "I need you" into the microphone.
Say "I want you" into the microphone.
Amazing... I wonder who built it.
That voice... Could that be ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Wha... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲!? You've gotten so small and cute...
You got a problem with that！
No, no. By the way, what is this place？
This place？ This is my secret base！
Aha, you must be a seekrit agint！
You came to snoop around my secret base, right!? Didn't you!!
Sh-shut up！ Well, you could say that...
Anyway！ If you're not a seekrit agint, say the pledge！
Anyone in my kingdom knows it！
It's "Nene-sama, banzaaai！" Come on, say it！
Why you～！ You're a seekrit agint after all！
Shut up！ I'm gonna beat you to a pulp～！
Phew... I almost got beaten to a pulp...
Little ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ couldn't really have been that wild, right？
Then I'll make you my underling！
Yes, Your Majesty！ I'm deeply grateful！
Then I'll give you your first mission right away！
Uhh... three onions and three potatoes, two carrots... and 250 grams of beef...
Anyway！ Go buy the stuff on this memo！
That's right！ My job is your job！ Your job you do yourself！
Hey, Nene！ Here again！ What happened to the shopping!?
Th-the shopping... my underling was just about to go... right！ Right！
This child, saying things like that again！ That's enough, come home！
I'm so sorry, really. This child always acts like a boy！ Come on, we're going home！
Anyway... so the menu was curry, huh.
Geez... this is the hot spring. We snuck away here, just the two of us, remember？
Hehe, you're still half asleep. Look, the sun's gone down... the moon is so pretty...
A relaxing trip like this is nice, isn't it...
(More than that... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s profile in the moonlight... she's so beautiful.)
Ahh, the breeze feels nice too... perfect after a bath.
(...The breeze carries the scent of soap from ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Ahh, the breeze feels so nice.
While you were asleep, I went into the hot spring again. That's three times already. I might get lightheaded. Hehe.
Why don't you go in once more later too？ You probably sweated while you were sleeping, right？
Ah, right. After you get out of the bath, want to take a walk outside to cool off？ A moon-viewing stroll. Not bad, right？
(Tonight ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ seems so grown-up... it's almost unreal that she's my girlfriend...)
Hehe. A trip with just you and me... I hesitated at first, but coming here was the right call. It makes me want to come again together...
(...Am I really worthy of ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ I'm suddenly getting worried...)
What's wrong？ You've been spacing out for a while. Hehe. Could it be you're still sleepy？
Why is ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ dating someone like me？
Why... isn't it obvious？ It's because...
I guess so, but... why do you love me？
...you're cool, kind, cute but dependable, you treasure me, and also...
H-hey, wait, wait. I'm being serious...
Ah, a dream... I wish she really thought that...
(The breeze after a bath feels nice...)
Hey, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ What's wrong, out in the middle of the night？
This area's been dangerous lately because of those incidents.
Fine...？ You're not fine at all.
Your face is pale too. Are you sick？
Anyway, it's dangerous for you to be alone. I'll walk you home.
What are you saying！ There's no way I could forget！
It's no use... I can never see you again...
Stop talking nonsense, let's go home, come on！
Go, before I stop being myself！ Please...
(Let me take a good look at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.)
I've been defiled... so just leave me alone...
Those incidents of people being attacked by a vampire... don't tell me, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Stop... don't look at me with those eyes！
Even the sun has forsaken me... so you too... forget about me？
What nonsense！ How could I abandon my beloved ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Thank you... me too... I love you too.
With those words in my heart... I will live on alone in the darkness. Forever...
I'll become a vampire too！ And then we'll live together forever！
No... I could never do something like that！
As long as I can be with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, I don't care. Come on, drink as much as you want！
Really？ Then, don't mind if I do！ Actually, I was starving～.
Huh!? For real？ I mean... you know, um...
U-um... what did you eat today？
Phew... saved... huh？ Oh, a dream.
...That doesn't count as abandoning her, right？
(Huh？ What's that wound on her neck？)
(Before I get eaten, let me breathe out and calm down...)
Touch the wound on her neck.
Yes, one pancake and drink bar set. Certainly～.
Geez... "what are you doing" isn't the question, is it？ We're working, so you have to stay focused, okay？
Hehe. Okay, sleepyhead, please clear table 3.
Thank you for waiting. Are you ready to order？
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s uniform seems a little smaller than usual...)
Thank you very much. We look forward to seeing you again.
Once the lunch rush is over, we can take a break, so hang in there, okay？ Hehehe.
Okay... ah, a call from table 5？
Eek, no... what do I do... it looks like it broke...
Let me see... you're right. It won't close...
I don't think so？ The uniform's just small.
But even my school uniform's a bigger size now than when I started...
No, that's not gaining weight, that's growing. You're young, after all.
Of course, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ isn't fat at all.
Good... I didn't know what I'd do if you thought I'd gotten fat...
The part about being young, is that true too？
Good！ Then I have to get back to work.
Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！ Your zipper's still broken！
Diplo... but ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s graduation isn't yet...
No. I'm graduating now. Look, the cherry blossoms too...
Huh？ Oh, you're right. I see... so you're graduating.
Yeah. Now I can graduate from you.
Yeah, congrat... huh？ Graduate from what, just now...？
It's sad... but I'm graduating. I have to.
Because you don't need me anymore, do you？
That's not true！ That's absolutely not true!!
Liar. You never come to see me.
No... it's okay now. I understand.
...Huh？ Could it be that was... a dream？ Thank goodness...
...Where am I？ Wait, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ What's wrong？
...Mm, looks like I caught a bit of a cold... cough, cough... thanks for coming to visit me today.
A cold？ How are you feeling？
Yeah, I'm getting a little better...
Really？ Um, what about your fever...？
I see... oh right. You should get some nutrition. Is there anything you want to eat？
I don't have much appetite... ah.
Grated apple, got it. Mind if I borrow the kitchen？
...Hehe, then maybe I'll let myself be spoiled...
Hey... I have one more favor to ask...
It's still hard to sit up... will you feed me？
Um... you can't eat on your own？
...I kind of want you to feed me... is that no good？
N-no, it's fine！ ...Then, open your mouth. Here.
Mmph. That's not my mouth... meanie.
Mm... hehe, yummy. Hey, more... okay？ Here, aah～.
(Is it because she's weak from being sick？ Today ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ is like a kid, and kind of cute.)
...That was delicious. Thank you so much. I feel like I'm getting better.
Yeah, good. If your appetite's back, I'm relieved. You'll get better soon.
Maybe I don't want to get better just yet...
Spoiled, kid-like ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ was so cute...
